title: Floods in Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra worsen due to heavy rainfall
summary: Heavy rainfall has caused flooding in several districts of Madhya Pradesh, including Burhanpur, Khindawar, and Khandwa. The Tapti River's water level has risen by over 2 meters above the danger mark, with similar concerns reported along the Narmada River. The government has been warned about the potential for landslides and flash floods in several areas. The situation is being closely monitored by authorities.
